response_target.name: first_official_county_infestation_designation
response_target.risk_set: all frozen Census counties not officially designated infested by source year t
response_target.positive: first official designation occurs by t+1
response_target.boundary: recorded designation status, not latent biological absence
response_target.positive_registry_rule: after once-only response opening, use only rows with infested=1 to reconstruct cumulative positive FIPS sets; counties absent from the positive registry remain recorded non-designated for this endpoint
response_target.validation_check: cumulative positive FIPS counts must exactly equal 1,3,7,17,45,57,84,130 for 2014-2021 before any model fit

temporal_design.rule_state_update_during_heldout: allowed only after each heldout transition outcome is observed

layer_a.current_sources: all counties officially designated infested by source year t
layer_a.source_weights: equal normalized weight across current sources
layer_a.local_kernel_scale_interpretation: response-blind analyst-choice scale equal to the frozen LCC50 threshold; not a biological dispersal estimate

rules.interpretation: admissible nonzero long-distance possibility world motivated by human-mediated SLF transport; not a calibrated transport probability

layer_a.transition_normalization: Q[s,j]=W[s,j]/(1+sum_k W[s,k]); candidate support is the equal-source mean of Q[s,j]
layer_a.rule_filter: after each observed transition, eliminate a surviving rule if any newly designated positive county has support <=1e-15
layer_a.monotonicity: surviving rule IDs may only remain or contract; eliminated rules never return
layer_a.falsification: if all five rules are eliminated, stop and report frozen-universe falsification without retuning

layer_b.implementation: call production summarize_worldset_for_prediction on a forecast-like object containing only the surviving per-world support matrices

representation_estimability.scope: calibration rows after once-only response opening but before heldout scoring
representation_estimability.rule: after dropping zero-SD columns, regress each Layer-B feature not already in mean-only by OLS on intercept + shared baseline + mean-only EOG features; require at least one residual SD >1e-8
representation_estimability.no_rescue: do not add features/worlds or redefine mean-only after this check

metrics.outer_units: the three heldout annual transitions; county rows do not create independent years

layer_b_vs_mean_only_favorable_if_all: Layer B has lower log loss in at least 2 of 3 heldout transitions
decision_rules.layer_b_vs_mean_only_adverse_if: macro logloss(layer_b - mean_only) > 0 and Layer B loses in at least 2 of 3 heldout transitions
external_added_value_favorable_if_all: macro Layer-B log loss is lower than geometry_process_logistic and geometry_process_rf
Layer B beats the better external baseline in at least 2 of 3 heldout transitions
decision_rules.otherwise: preserve no_confirmed_added_value, adverse, non_estimable or universe_falsified without retuning

no_retuning_after_response: five Layer-A rules or their kernels/thresholds
